The blue photograph contains an app screenshot, excluded by the source-photo aperture hole. Exact AA/pixel-glass pose and shell finish remain approximate, and secondESP32/battery/socket internal geometry is omitted.

Official black SKU option is retained independently; no separate black factory photograph was found in this bounded source set. The black model has an untextured front instead of passing a recolored blue image off as source.

Exterior printed dimensions retained; 1.5mm wall/cap thickness, simplified corner/side profiles and unannotated port positions are explicit estimates. Only visible openings are approximated; no screw threads, hidden electronics, battery, seals or connector mating model is invented.
